description: Enjoy an exceptional Parisian experience in this superb high-end duplex, ideally located in the heart of the capital. Designed to accommodate up to 10 guests, it offers 4 stylish bedrooms, 2 modern bathrooms and beautiful living areas. Just a stone's throw from Le Sentier, the Grands Boulevards, the best places to visit, shops and monuments, enjoy a stylish, comfortable and ultra-central stay, perfect for families or friends. A place to experience Paris with style, space and elegance.The spaceThis duplex apartment has been designed to offer a comfortable, elegant and high-end stay. Located on the 4th floor without an elevator, it has spacious rooms and a pleasant layout, ideal for making the most of your stay in Paris.The property has a lovely, cosy living room with a lounge area and a welcoming dining area.The kitchen is fully equipped and provides everything you need for your meals and breakfasts: coffee capsules, sugar, tea, hobs, oven, microwave oven, kettle, Nespresso machine and toaster.The duplex includes several comfortable bedrooms, designed to ensure peace and privacy. In particular, you will find 4 queen-size beds measuring 160 cm, as well as 2 single beds measuring 90 cm.Two modern bathrooms are at your disposal, with shower gel, shampoo and a hairdryer, as well as toilets located throughout the property for added comfort.Numerous amenities are available: TV, free Wi-Fi, fully equipped kitchen, hairdryer and everything you need for a pleasant stay.Bed linen and a set of shower towels per person are provided.Spacious, comfortable and perfectly equipped, this apartment is ideal for a stay with family or friends, with all the charm of a genuine Parisian duplex.Guest accessFeel at home here!
